description: Batch Google web search. Send 1 to 10 queries in one call; returns up to 10 ranked results per query (title, URL, snippet, date) in the order sent, for one flat price. Cheaper than /v1/web-search from 3 queries; for 1 or 2 use /v1/web-search. Typical response 2 to 4 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0115 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case, such as us or gb.

language.description: Optional language code, lower case, such as en or pt-br.

queries.description: 1 to 10 searches, each as typed into a search engine.

name: quantagentshop_web_search_batch
title: Web search batch
